name: Sarthak Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1982, Sarthak Industries Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacturing of LPG 
Cylinders.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SIL manufactures liquefied petroleum gas cylinders. Apart 
From this, the company also engages in the trading of vanaspati ghee, agricultural and non-agricultural commodities, mining, and the mineral-based industry on an opportunistic basis.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.74 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 56.4 to 22.8 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 140 days to 36.3 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.56% over last 3 years.
